title: Ethiopian Fir Fir Pastry
description: A traditional Ethiopian pastry with a warm and smoky flavor, wrapped in a flaky puff pastry crust.

ingredients.name: Warm spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger

instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, mix fir fir flour, warm spices, smoked paprika, fir fir sugar, egg, and salt.
Place the fir fir mixture in the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around it.
Brush the edges of the pastry with water.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to create a decorative edge.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
